decisions.statement: The email and password come from the environment rather than from a value in this file.
The throwaway identity and the real identity read from separate environment variables.
The real identity is admitted only as a deliberate read-only opt-in.
SUPABASE_STORAGE_KEY is the localStorage key the app's supabase client reads.

definition: password sign-in against supabase yielding a session and the user id it belongs to
